controls: Explicit execution flag; fixed private source and single live-marked SQL target; byte-verified source snapshot and post-run parity.
New UUID-named and labeled container, local PostgreSQL image resolved to immutable image ID, loopback-only dynamic host port.
Private generated credentials and four independent roles; database, role, server address, port and postmaster generation checked before test.
PostgreSQL: 512 MiB RAM, no additional swap, 0.5 CPU, 64 pids, 256 MiB data tmpfs, bounded statement and lock timeout.
Runner verifies outer 1 GiB RAM, zero swap, 0.5 CPU, 64 tasks; 300-second total deadline with 45-second cleanup reserve.
Cleanup verifies exact ID and ownership label before stopping/removing only the fixture container. Cleanup failure preserves failing exit status.
review_runner.scope: Synthetic role-separated SQL contract only. No candidate training, baseline measurement, Scorer service, GPU, local model or AOS proof.

findings.finding: bind, fail and complete compare claim.generation <> p_generation. SQL NULL yields UNKNOWN and fails to reject a missing expected generation. Python adapters do not repair the SQL authorization boundary.
findings.minimal_fix: Use IS DISTINCT FROM and reject malformed required identity arguments. Add direct Scorer-role NULL-generation tests asserting rejection and unchanged claim, budget, receipt and control rows.

findings.finding: Recovery returns succeeded/failed solely from claim state before observing the recorded worker. After receipt commit but before worker teardown, a resumed grid driver can start the next claim while the old worker still holds the process admission lock. capacity_busy then terminally fails that next claim and the calibration.
findings.minimal_fix: Retain the committed terminal receipt, but return pending until exact recorded worker/cgroup/sandbox drain is verified; then report terminal success/failure to the grid driver. Cover live-terminal, drained-terminal and uncertain-identity observations without rewriting the terminal receipt.

findings.finding: Neither the CLI calibration driver nor the supervisor guarantees that the host Scorer P1 admission lock is free. One legitimate busy observation immediately returns capacity_busy; the supervisor then fails the reserved cell and entire calibration.
findings.minimal_fix: Wait for the same host process admission lock in a bounded short-sleep loop before heavy imports and binding, using the original worker monotonic deadline already clamped to claim/job deadlines. Recompute remaining time after acquisition. Do not reserve again, refund budget, increment generation or introduce another attempt. Test busy-to-available and busy-through-original-deadline.

findings.finding: Worker result parser requires a calibration_id key but does not compare its value to the expected calibration. Authoritative database checks already bind actual execution to calibration_id, so no cross-calibration execution bypass was demonstrated.
findings.minimal_fix: Pass the expected calibration_id to the parser and compare it alongside claim_id and generation.

findings.finding: Fixture expects ValueError for conflicting freeze. The new SQL finalizer raises P0001 through SQLAlchemy DBAPIError and the Python helper does not translate it.
findings.minimal_fix: Assert DBAPIError plus P0001 and the exact freeze-conflict message.

findings.finding: Fixture expects direct Scorer INSERT to reach the sealed-cell trigger. Migration 0023 revokes this INSERT permission, so PostgreSQL returns 42501 before trigger execution.
findings.minimal_fix: Assert privilege denial for direct insertion. Exercise immutable receipt conflict separately through the authorized completion function.

positive_source_findings: Exact task/algorithm/seed unique claim prevents a second reservation for the same cell. Existing-claim replay does not refund or charge again.
15 immutable tasks times three fixed algorithms times seeds 0,1,2 bounds the grid at 135 claims; fixed 100-second reservations total 13500 seconds within the 14400-second job cap.
Reservation, binding, receipt publication and finalization use the persisted absolute database deadline. Repeated provision does not create a new deadline.
Control/job/claim row locking serializes admission and terminal receipt publication. A receipt and its succeeded claim are committed atomically.
Completion validates generation, invocation, task provenance, deadline and control eligibility; exact previously committed receipt replay is allowed after deadline without producing another row.

Worker runs in the aggregate Scorer slice with 2 GiB memory, zero swap, one CPU, 32 tasks, fixed runtime bound and host process admission lock. Candidate container has independent 2 GiB/one CPU/64-pid bounds and fixed pinned image.
Claim execution rereads durable time after loading inputs and checks admission before sandbox phases. SQL rejects late publication.
Failure reconciliation uses recorded boot/PID/start identity, exact systemd invocation/cgroup and owned sandbox marker protocol. Unavailable boot identity remains unresolved.

verification_status.worker_reported: 14 pure tests, Ruff, py_compile and strict mypy of seven runtime files passed using explicit private PYTHONPATH.
verification_status.note: Initial freeze was lifted by root for these findings. Corrections require fresh source hashes and follow-up source review before an integration approval.

next_required_research_restart_slice.first_slice: Unify queued dispatch and raw lab run behind one owner-aware entrypoint. Add immutable owner-generation history and a current-owner pointer for the same admitted research intent, with a migration numbered after the reserved 0024 baseline migration.
next_required_research_restart_slice.transaction_boundary: Every Director mutation, Planner admission and late completion/failure must verify the expected generation in its committing transaction under the same lock order as takeover. Heartbeat on another connection is insufficient.
next_required_research_restart_slice.recovery_boundary: Permit a new generation only after exact old-owner and owned-child drain, current-run/nonterminal/no-stop checks and unchanged suite/harness/image/provider pins. Preserve global admission limits.
next_required_research_restart_slice.rollout: Keep continuation unavailable until all mutation sites are fenced. Then wire durable absolute deadline, nonrefundable one-retry reservation and pre-Scorer evaluation evidence into existing component checkpoint replay.
minimal_acceptance: Two recovery contenders yield one new generation.
Old generation cannot append, dispatch or terminalize after takeover.
Stop wins against recovery and prevents new work.
Raw CLI cannot bypass current owner/global admission.
Subsequent continuation proof preserves budget and retry allowance across real process loss.
next_required_research_restart_slice.scope_note: Standalone baseline admission/CLI is independent work. Existing component checkpoint replay does not close the required research restart/reconcile obligation.
